description: This file declares the interface for WAN Manager IPC functionalities, including sending messages, starting IPC server, and setting interface status. It also includes relevant headers and conditional compilation for health check messaging.

methods.name: WanMgr_SendMsgToIHC
methods.description: Sends an IPoE health check message to IHC if FEATURE_IPOE_HEALTH_CHECK is enabled.

methods.name: WanMgr_StartIpcServer
methods.description: Start the IPC server for WAN Manager clients.

methods.name: Wan_ForceRenewDhcpIPv6
methods.description: Force renew DHCPv6 configuration on the specified interface.

methods.name: WanMgr_SetInterfaceStatus
methods.description: Set the status of a WAN interface.
